help.title: Help and user guides
status.timeout: The end-to-end generation deadline expired. No authoritative result was saved; this does not prove infeasibility.
status.failure: The worker was interrupted or failed. No authoritative result was saved. Review the run conflicts before retrying.
status.unknown: The solver stopped without proving feasibility or infeasibility. Review diagnostics or retry with a different configuration.
status.cancelled: Generation cancelled on the server. No result was saved.
